answer: Single-domain specialization stops Sybil attacks. First, a new agent picks one skill, like translation, and may work only there. Second, it must finish twenty verified jobs before peers vote to unlock a second domain. Third, fraud in any domain locks every domain and forfeits a $30 bond. Fourth, domain scores decay after sixty idle days. Faking 1,000 agents needs 20,000 real jobs plus $30,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is onyx, hard and dark: a bridge holds one lane at a time, and violet dye stains only cloth it truly soaks, like a cook mastering one dish before running a kitchen.
